svg.title: CONS-02 — Console over active gameplay
svg.desc: 1280 by 900 desktop debug client. A full-width opaque console overlays the upper arena without changing the single shared view. The console contains history, separator, input and cursor. Gameplay and shared held keyboard/controller state continue; discrete context key events belong to the console. Notes outside the client are not game UI.

g.text: ANNOTATIONS — not UI. Same console geometry as CONS-01; client width changes, not the console text scale.
The opaque console obscures upper HUD/world content. No Pause, close button, translucency or view-layout control is added.
Simulation continues. Discrete key events belong to the console; held keyboard/controller state may still cause player actions.
History/input scrolling cues and production colors remain in the owning specification. The arena is schematic, not a new level.
